Notification only; nothing is installed without you.
Signed, compatible updates are installed on their own and take effect at next start. Off by default.

Fully close and reopen the app for the change to take effect.
Signature valid, every file hash matches.

Keep its settings and data (config, state, sessions) or delete them too?
Stop the script before updating it.
No previous version to roll back to.
Off by default. Only verified scripts, and only if the update asks for no new network access.
There is no upload server: the button opens a GitHub issue form in the catalog repository. The owner reviews the script and adds it to the catalog with the Verified label.
This script was not reviewed by the catalog owner. It runs with access to your Telegram account and can read and send messages, use the network and your LLM. Install only code you trust.
I understand the risk and trust the author
The scan is a static hint, not a guarantee: code can build addresses and calls at runtime.
Script %1$s is already installed from another source. Delete it first.
Community source: its signature only proves the index came from its author. The script is NOT verified or reviewed by the TgAuto owner.
Community source without a key: the catalog is unsigned and can be forged. The script is NOT verified or reviewed.
The official catalog is built in. Community repositories are added by you: their scripts are never marked Verified or Official and are updated only manually.
Remove this source from the list? Scripts already installed from it stay.
Enter an https:// address of index.json.
The key must be 64 hex characters (Ed25519 public key) or empty.

A community source is not reviewed by the TgAuto owner. Its scripts run with access to your Telegram account, the network and your LLM. They will be shown as Unverified and need your confirmation every time; updates are manual.
No key given: the catalog will be treated as unsigned and package signatures are not checked.
